"PRORIS: Epochs of Life
​Game Concept @COMMENT_BODY@ Design Document
​1. Core Concept @COMMENT_BODY@ Atmosphere
​ARK-Style Survival Freedom: Seamless open world, realistic physics, dynamic ecosystem loops, and hardcore survival mechanics.
​Diverse Prehistoric Fauna: Features not just dinosaurs, but Ice Age megafauna (Mammoths, Smilodons), giant prehistoric birds (Terror Birds, Argentavis), massive amphibians (Diplocaulus, Eryops), and apex reptiles coexisting in a single environment.
​Multiplayer Dynamics: Clan (pack/tribe) mechanics, territorial control wars, cooperative hunting raids, and an organic trading ecosystem.
​2. Class @COMMENT_BODY@ Evolution System
​Instead of the standard human-taming-dinos setup, players directly embody and evolve prehistoric fauna through a dedicated tree of life.
​Starting Classes
​1. Avian (Scouts / Aerial Hunters): Masters of the sky (Pterosaurs, Giant Birds). Focuses on rapid map reconnaissance, aerial diving attacks, and high-altitude nesting.
​2. Mammals (Speed / Pack Intelligence / Cold Resistance): Smilodons, Woolly Mammoths, etc. Benefits from pack synergy buffs, cave shelter advantages, and night vision capabilities.
​3. Amphibians @COMMENT_BODY@ Semi-Aquatics (Swamp Control): Sarcosuchus, Spinosaurus-like builds, and giant amphibians. Capable of underwater breathing, mud camouflage, and riverway control.
​4. Dinosaurs @COMMENT_BODY@ Reptiles (Brute Force / Armor / Dominance): T-Rex, Triceratops, Ankylosaurus types focusing on raw power, heavy armor, and frontline crowd control.
​Evolution Mechanics
​DNA @COMMENT_BODY@ Mutation Progression: Earn DNA points by hunting, surviving harsh conditions, and extracting fossil energy deposits across the map.
​Genetic Adaptation: Spend points to evolve from a small starter specimen into an customized Apex predator. Apply traits such as reinforced armor plating, venomous bites, aerodynamic feather structures, or nocturnal thermal vision.
​3. Dynamic Open-World @COMMENT_BODY@ Ecosystem
​Living Food Web: AI fauna follows realistic ecological behaviors—forming herds, migrating, drinking at water sources, and hunting dynamically. Over-hunting herbivores causes local carnivore populations to starve or become aggressively hostile toward player bases.
​Environmental Events: Dynamic Ice Age cycles, massive monsoon rainstorms, volcanic eruptions, and droughts continuously shift the map geometry and animal migration paths.
​Biomes: Deep swamps, red canyon deserts, glacial peaks, ancient dense jungles, and oceanic trenches—each housing unique evolution resources.
​4. PvP Combat @COMMENT_BODY@ Class Synergy
​PvP revolves around ecological adaptations, biome-specific advantages, and species-tailored pack tactics rather than conventional weaponry. (3D Game, Desktop)
